name: mcp-config-manager
stderr:
Usage: mcp-config-manager [options] [command]

CLI to manage MCP configurations across different AI clients

Options:
  -v, --version                                        output the current version
  -h, --help                                           display help for command

Commands:
  list                                                 List all supported clients and their config status
  show <client>                                        Show MCP servers for a client
  add [options] <client> <serverName>                  Add a new MCP server to a client
  remove <client> <serverName>                         Remove an MCP server from a client (use "all" for client to remove from all)
  copy [options] <fromClient> <serverName> <toClient>  Copy an MCP server from one client to another (use "all" for toClient to copy to all)
  env <client> <serverName> <action> [key] [value]     Manage environment variables (action: set|unset|list)
  export [options] <client> [output]                   Export configuration for a client
  import <client> <file>                               Import configuration to a client
  env-view [options]                                   View all environment variables across all configs (reverse view)
  env-update-all [options] <key> [value]               Update an environment variable across all configs where it exists
  web [options]                                        Start the web UI server
  start [options]                                      Start the web UI server in background
  stop                                                 Stop the background web UI server
  status                                               Check status of background web UI server
  help [command]                                       display help for command
